name: Sakai Ayako
source:
She is 20 years old. A young wife whose husband is apparently having an affair.

She has no children yet. She is very active with her youthful body. While discussing her husband with the protagonist, she began depending on him mentally and physically.

Her sexual desire, which has been ignored up to now, runs rampant...
